name: test_hydrate_p95_under_500ms
reason: the 400 ms per-source budget is unenforceable on Windows: services/agent_hydrator.py:275 builds its cache client with socket_timeout=0.3 and NO socket_connect_timeout, and the call is a BLOCKING one inside a coroutine, so asyncio.wait_for cannot cancel it. Connecting to a port nothing listens on is instant (ECONNREFUSED) on POSIX and ~2 s of SYN retransmission on Windows. Measured on pytest (windows-latest), run 43366250606: 19 of 19 samples between 2008.0 and 2036.1 ms, a 28 ms spread -- a fixed wait, not a latency distribution.
owner: Phase 100 (quality gates own the per-cell budgets and the canary re-baseline)
exit_criterion: services/agent_hydrator.py passes socket_connect_timeout beside socket_timeout (one keyword at :275), which bounds the connect on every platform and restores the 400 ms budget. That file is CANARY-PINNED, so the plan that makes the edit pays the re-baseline; plan 89-07 may not touch it.
